name: shop-pot
task: Whenever the pot boils over, turn the stove down.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: the task 'Whenever the pot boils over, turn the stove down' is a whenever rule, so the single hard Response(pot_boiling, stove_fixed) is the correct template with the right argument order. pot_boiling is a lasting condition that stays on until the stove is turned down, and stove_fixed is the one-step event that ends it, so the response closes exactly when the agent turns the stove down during a boil, and it is owed again on every new boil. pot_boiling is only an 'if/whenever' condition, not a commanded goal, so no Existence is needed and the rule-only warning is valid.

texts: Whenever pot_boiling happens, stove_fixed must happen later
machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES:
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, pot_boiling&!stove_fixed) -> u1
(u1, stove_fixed) -> u0
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, pot_boiling&!stove_fixed, u1) -> -1
(u1, stove_fixed, u0) -> 1
